name: Skhovani vid zhyttya
source:
In an old mysterious mansion, among a series of bizarre rooms with equally bizarre inhabitants, a soul appeared. It took the form of a beautiful porcelain doll. How can you save it from oblivion?

Complete tasks assigned by the characters to move on through the estate. The choices you make will determine your fate.

[translated from [url=https://koshimore.itch.io/hiddenfromlife]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一座古老的神秘宅邸中，在一系列奇异的房间和同样奇异的居民中，一个灵魂出现了。它的形状是一个美丽的瓷娃娃。你怎样才能把它从遗忘中拯救出来呢？

完成角色分配的任务，在庄园中继续前进。你所做的选择将决定你的命运。

[译自[url=https://koshimore.itch.io/hiddenfromlife]itch.io[/url]]
